{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: test

on: ["push", "pull_request"]

env:
  GO_VERSION: "1.22"
  LINUX_ARCHES: "amd64 386 arm arm64 s390x mips64le ppc64le"

jobs:
  lint:
    name: Lint
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: setup go
        uses: actions/setup-go@0a12ed9d6a96ab950c8f026ed9f722fe0da7ef32  # v5.0.2
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332  # v4.1.7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - uses: ibiqlik/action-yamllint@2576378a8e339169678f9939646ee3ee325e845c  # v3.1.1
        with:
          format: auto
          config_file: .yamllint.yaml

      - uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@aaa42aa0628b4ae2578232a66b541047968fac86  # v6.1.0
        with:
          args: --verbose
          version: v1.57.1

  build:
    name: Build all linux architectures
    needs: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: setup go
        uses: actions/setup-go@0a12ed9d6a96ab950c8f026ed9f722fe0da7ef32  # v5.0.2
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332  # v4.1.7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Build on all supported architectures
        run: |
          set -e
          for arch in ${LINUX_ARCHES}; do
            echo "Building for arch $arch"
            GOARCH=$arch go build ./...
          done

  test-linux:
    name: Run tests on Linux amd64
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: setup go
        uses: actions/setup-go@0a12ed9d6a96ab950c8f026ed9f722fe0da7ef32  # v5.0.2
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332  # v4.1.7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: Install test binaries
        run: |
          go install github.com/mattn/goveralls@v0.0.12
          go install github.com/modocache/gover@latest

      - name: test
        run: COVERALLS=1 ./test.sh

      - env:
          COVERALLS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        name: Send coverage to coveralls
        run: |
          PATH=$PATH:$(go env GOPATH)/bin
          gover
          goveralls -coverprofile=gover.coverprofile -service=github

  test-win:
    name: Build and run tests on Windows
    needs: build
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: setup go
        uses: actions/setup-go@0a12ed9d6a96ab950c8f026ed9f722fe0da7ef32  # v5.0.2
        with:
          go-version: ${{ env.GO_VERSION }}

      - uses: actions/checkout@692973e3d937129bcbf40652eb9f2f61becf3332  # v4.1.7

      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}

      - name: test
        run: bash ./test.sh",
  "rationale": "The repository is a Go project (go.mod/go.sum present) whose workflow runs setup-go, checkout, then go build/go test in every job on fresh runners with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9) measured adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed by go.mod/go.sum after checkout in a Go workflow, with successful runs and ~6% elapsed savings. Prerequisites are met: repeated dependency fetching occurs, cache inputs include the lockfile (go.sum) and go.mod, and no equivalent cache exists. Adding the same cache step after checkout in each Go job preserves all build/test steps and coverage while reducing repeated module downloads. No permissions are weakened, no new secrets/network/publishing added.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9"]
}
